title: Muskegon Lake had 347,350 tons of debris and 190,000 tons of contaminated soil removed
summary_full: Muskegon Lake in Michigan has been officially delisted from the EPA's Areas of Concern list, marking a monumental milestone in restoration efforts. Over decades, key initiatives addressed challenges such as habitat degradation, pollution in soils, and shoreline hardening. With around $80 million dedicated to the cause, revitalized wetland habitats now support thriving fish and wildlife communities. This achievement heralds a brighter future for both the environment and local residents.
